secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase Web API Key — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase Auth Domain (e.g. your-project.firebaseapp.com) — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase Storage Bucket (e.g. your-project.appspot.com) — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Messaging Sender ID — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase App ID — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General > Web app config

secrets.name: SQUADCO_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: SquadCo payment gateway secret key — from SquadCo dashboard > Settings > API

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase Project ID for backend admin SDK — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General

secrets.name: FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL
secrets.description: Firebase service account client email — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts > generate new private key JSON (client_email field)

secrets.name: FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase service account private key — from Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts > generate new private key JSON (private_key field). Use \n for newlines.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Firebase Realtime Database URL (e.g. https://your-project-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com) — from Firebase Console > Realtime Database
